name: Mushroom and lentil protein bowl
description: A soy-free plant protein bowl for lunch or dinner: mushrooms seared hard in dry pans, warm cooked lentils and a large amount of wilted spinach, finished with sunflower seeds and torn basil.
instructions: Set two wide non-stick pans over high heat, divide the mushrooms between them in a single layer and leave them undisturbed for 3 minutes so they brown rather than steam.
Stir once, add the salt, and cook for 3 minutes more until the pans are dry again.
Divide the lentils between the pans and warm them through for 2 minutes.
Fold in the spinach a large handful at a time and cook for 2 minutes, just until it collapses.
Divide between two bowls, then scatter the sunflower seeds and the torn basil over the top.
